objective.text: Obsidian must open project Brain records from the index note. With `canonical: workspace` and an index note in a vault, every valid record outside the vault root gets a generated read-only copy at `<note folder>/Records/<slug>.md` (frontmatter `agentos_mirror_of`, `source`, `source_hash`, `mirror_hash`, `tags: [agentos-mirror]`, no `id:`), and the index links to it. No generated link may leave the vault. An edited copy is never overwritten or deleted and is warned about; in-workspace `knowledge/` gets `Records/.gitignore` (`*`). `canonical: vault`, `context`, checkpoints and clones without `.agentos/local.yaml` stay unchanged.

acceptance.text:
- After `agentos checkpoint --task <id> --next "<action>"`, `agentos status`, `agentos context <engine> --task <id>` and `agentos resume --task <id>` present exactly one current next action: the most recently saved one.
- Older or contradicting next-action text in handoff.md or tasks.md is not presented as current; the next agent can tell it is superseded.
- Nothing is silently deleted.
